LATEST AUTHORIAL DUEL CROSS-WORLD IDENTITY ROUTING — 7 OCTOBER 2026
Micah Bell's crossover presence includes the genuine consciousness of Bob Ross (fictional two-mind/split-personality characterization). Establish how that mind shares Micah and how both arrived; no free new body, childhood rewrite, clinical assertion or invented power. Chris's "Colm O'Driscoll" opponent is in fact Stephen Hawking in a disguise which drops only after Chris kills the apparent Colm in a FUTURE UNPLAYED scene. The original RDR2 Colm is not being imported, secretly resurrected or recast as Hawking in the source game; his original hanging is unchanged. A new actual-person arrival/disguise requires physical means, source-time and specific evidence. Author-selected end: Chris hesitates before killing for a reason actually available to him, then kills, then witnesses Hawking identity revealed; do not give prior awareness without a clue. No implied historical claims about real Hawking or Ross.


CURRENT CHRIS 1V1 CROSSOVER ROUTING (LATEST AUTHOR CORRECTION)
Selected Chris opponents: Micah Bell (RDR2), Jack Marston (ADULT 1914 RDR1), Eyehole Man, Colm O'Driscoll (RDR2), Mr. Nimbus. Old Dutch-only gang-import correction remains controlling: the old Micah whole-gang entry is inactive. Micah requires independent crossing and a genuinely co-present Bob Ross consciousness. The apparent Colm requires an actual Stephen Hawking arrival and disguise; the original RDR2 Colm still dies by hanging in 1899, and Micah does not automatically survive his 1907 source death. Each needs actual route, source year, location and evidenced encounter. The already indexed adult Jack key is jack_marston_1914_adult immediately POST Ross killing, not another imported child Jack or a copy of John; its old registry alone does not show current Noxus whereabouts. Dutch late Chapter 3, Arthur later memories, adult Jack 1914 knowledge and Chris's confirmed RDR2 game experience remain separate. No mandatory fight or world teleport; previous South Park/League matchup leads now superseded.

LATEST WORLD CAST EXCLUSION / BRIAR ENCOUNTER GEOGRAPHY
Varus is NOT part of the newly selected Darkin project story roster, although Riot-source historical documentation may name him. Briar is ALREADY a Noxian native and source-established escapee from captivity; an IV.3 Black Rose-connected works encounter must show a current reason she is there (e.g. a handler or recognizable restraint trying to reassert control), not summon her magically or reset her prison history. Frank's early III.4 departure is only discovered as absence the next morning. It creates no established destination, travel time or later scene; do not infer a Zaun arrival or show him again. Equipment/custody and real exit access remain required without a departure montage.

CURRENT EXTENDED DARKIN WORLD REGISTER
Route the 23 selected named Darkin through topic_sources/Darkin_Continuity_and_Deployment_Source.txt; Varus is excluded from the project's deployed extended cast. Extant weapons, local custodians and possible hosts are not a new portal network or evidence every Darkin is within Noxus; ancient dead are history only. This author selection adds no current live position or event. Use credible regional geography, travel and evidence to develop any Darkin route.

GEOLOGICAL / REGIONAL GATES FOR AUTHOR-APPROVED EIGHT-BY-FIVE DUELS
Prospective signature 1v1 targets span multiple established regions: Noxus/Sion/Samira/Talon; Zaun/Urgot/Dr. Mundo; Demacia/Galio/Vayne/Lucian's historic duty; Ionia/Wukong/Lee Sin/Sett/Akali/Kayn's movements/Yone and Zaahen's historical temple; Bilgewater/Tahm Kench/Nautilus/Pyke/Illaoi/Gangplank/Graves/Twisted Fate/Miss Fortune; Marai seas/Nami; Shuriman jungles or Void frontier/Nidalee/Rengar/Rek'Sai/Kha'Zix and Akshan's original Shuriman ties; Ixtal/Skarner; Shadow Isles/Kalista; Freljord/Gragas or mountains/Malphite and the sealed Bastion/Mordekaiser. These are broad source-associated regions, NOT asserted actual positions of individuals on the branch clock and not a new universal location map. Verify the living character's source-compatible current region and any chosen travel, actual time and motive when plotting. Use original Runeterra local references without instant Noxian transplant. Do not force all selected fights into the 21 Season 3 cards or create extra voyages as filler.

RUNETERRA WORLD, GEOGRAPHY AND TRAVEL

Owns the practical routing of host-world geography, elapsed travel, institutions and information movement. This is an application source over the complete recovered reference/runeterra modules, not a condensed replacement for the entire setting. Those modules and the completed travel research are included separately in the source pack.

HOST WORLD AND EVIDENCE
Runeterra remains an inhabited world with its own people and conflicts. An imported powerhouse does not convert native factions into spectators or automatically become a local god. Current explicit branch changes outrank an incompatible source-series event. Compatible official geography/background informs the setting; an older map caption does not undo later continuity. A LoR card interaction, gameplay statistic or thematic association is not automatically a delivered meeting or universal power scale.

Use the reference atlas and official map for relative placement, terrain and named places. Do not measure pixels into kilometers or treat a pin as a border, current political control or a personal residence. Noxus is an empire; the capital is not identical to its coastline. Basilich is a distinct port. Piltover and Zaun are linked urban environments whose actual levels, bridges, lifts and security determine access.

CURRENT FICTIONAL PLANNING ALLOWANCES
These are existing project defaults from event/season23_blueprint.md for the original conventional route assumptions, not universal travel times or mandatory boat journeys. The latest movement application is topic_sources/Season_3_SBU_Gang_Mobility_and_Fidelity_20261008.txt: choose among the gang's earned ways to travel and available conveyances, then derive credible time for that route. The old conventional planning values remain reference only:
- Piltover/Zaun to the Noxian capital: 28 days, working range 24–32.
- Reverse Noxian capital to Piltover/Zaun: same 28-day planning default; a shown route or disruption can differ.
- Piltover/Zaun to Bilgewater: 22-day default.
- Bilgewater to the Noxian capital: 33-day default.
Keep the original source's route assumptions. The historical Medarda chart and comic time transitions are evidence with different conditions, not competing automatic deadlines. Completed research and its limits live in reference/research/Runeterra_Travel_and_Noxus_Geography_Audit.md.

D120 departure and D148/R0 Noxian arrival belong to the inherited crossing plan; preserve any actually delivered crossing and its chronology. They are not the current cursor or a mandatory route for future journeys. When a boat is actually chosen, distinguish reaching a coast from reaching the capital. When a different valid means is chosen, update prospective arrival, reports and dependent encounters together. Removing Kaze's non-ocular portals removes shortcuts premised on them; a known destination alone supplies no passage, and his retained eyes do not grant international transport.

MOVEMENT AND NEWS
Before a consequential journey, establish departure, destination, passenger/cargo, available vehicle, route/access, elapsed allowance and actual disruption. Neither an outline nor an institution name supplies a ship, instant message or free access. Reports need witnesses or evidence, a carrier, arrival, interpretation and a resulting choice. Use Sins_Group_and_Reputation_Source.txt for public reputation so travel and rumor do not develop incompatible rules.

A real D84 dispatch could reach Bilgewater around D106 and, if forwarded promptly under the 33-day onward default, the capital around D139. These remain conditional examples. A later war report leaves later. The D120 serpent event cannot magically become common knowledge in distant Zaun that day; local warning and rescue may start immediately where observed.

SELECTED LATE-SEASON SETTING
Stage Thor/Jörmungandr's arrival in open water beside a Noxian coastal roadstead, with nearby working vessels and an accessible shore. This is a prospective ordinary coastal location, not a newly claimed official named port or an exact surveyed position. It keeps scale and sea access credible without placing the capital on the shore. Establish enough local geography in the actual scene for damage, evacuation, Thor's landfall and the serpent's retreat to remain intelligible.

Do not silently move an established city, instantly flood all Runeterra, freeze all regional trade or give every ship the same knowledge. Specific damage can close a channel, alter one sailing or create a paid escort opportunity; identify the affected route when using that consequence. Retain completed crossing facts; a prospective 28-day sailing estimate applies only if the chosen route and means support it. It cannot force the Sins to use a boat or suppress earned mobility.

DEEP RETRIEVAL
reference/runeterra/core.md: ontology, map policy, institutions and branch distinctions.
reference/runeterra/champion_appendix.md: individual native/regional entities.
reference/runeterra/key_profiles.md: dedicated major native profiles and evidence.
reference/research/Runeterra_Travel_and_Noxus_Geography_Audit.md: completed geography/travel analysis.
reference/research/Noxus_Cast_Fidelity_Research.md and League evidence ledgers: original research, with their dated cursor statements treated as history.


S3 CAPITAL ARRIVAL ANCHOR — QA RECONCILIATION
R0/D148 is arrival at the inland Noxian capital/its immediate freight approach, not first contact with the seacoast. The existing 28-day Piltover/Zaun-to-capital allowance includes sea passage, landing/transfer and the inland leg. Orient this briefly at I.1; the company holding is an inland freight/work site on that approach. Do not place ocean docks or the enormous serpent at the capital. Matt's two 28-day allowances likewise cover the total routes. The components' exact days remain uninstantiated until drafted; never add an instant coast-to-capital hop. Later coast/capital movement needs real travel and updates to dependent actions if delayed.

13:00 MOBILE CARGO CLARIFICATION — Billy can physically take whole accessible loads into existing BELLY and carry them as the exterior partner moves; cargo persists through Chris/Billy inversion. No paid warehouse or external haul is inherently required for goods already in their reach. Actual distance to uncollected goods and elapsed travel remain. A purchased delivery is an elective convenience/access bargain, not evidence of inadequate internal capacity. Future freight conflicts must survive this actual option instead of silently removing it.

CROSS-FRANCHISE CHRIS MATCHUP ROUTING — Eyehole Man (source Rick and Morty S2E8) and Mr. Nimbus (source Rick and Morty S5E1) are NOT Runeterran champions or automatic Noxian residents. Eyehole Man is an already admitted inherited crossover identity, but no active/current physical proximity follows from roster admission. Mr. Nimbus is a prospective crossover duel selection, not an independently enacted imported body. Establish actual branch arrival/location, available cereal or ocean stake, information carrier and transit before either matchup. Ziggs, Corki and Aphelios remain native Runeterran background references but are unselected for Chris; dormant research does not make them active opponents.

SUPERSEDED CHRIS MATCHUP / SOUTH PARK REEVE — Reeve is no longer a selected Chris opponent. The South Park satire source had NO automatically approved physical presence in Runeterra. The South Park parody actor, the real historical actor and the already listed Superman (Christopher Reeves film portrayal) are different source identities. Episode S7E2 ends with cartoon Reeve imprisoned in a Phantom Zone-like state. If choosing a pre-imprisonment source snapshot, establish the specific permitted temporal/dimensional import; if post-imprisonment, establish an actual release. Neither source option is a new arrival wave now. No spontaneous Legion of Doom support, supply or unlimited stem-cell power scaling.

# S37 research evidence scope

Preserved completed research with its original evidence limits and chronological addenda. Current selected baselines are resolved in event/roster.yaml and reference/imported_snapshot_fidelity.md; current sequence is event/season23_blueprint.md. Older alternatives and dated pending-work notes in this record are not executable overrides. No new research or universal full-performance PASS is claimed by packaging.

# Runeterra travel and Noxus geography — research delta

6 October 2026 UTC. Research only. Story remains paused after X.2; next X.3. This supplements the existing Runeterra bundle without replacing its atlas or changing the story.

## Bottom line

The supplied atlas is usable for relative placement. It is not a distance scale or a timetable. There **are** published journey figures: an older official Medarda trade chart marks Piltover–Bilgewater at 18 days and its Noxus route at 19 days. Those are historical, in-world trading benchmarks, not guaranteed Arcane-era journey times. [G1–G3]

## What was checked

- The supplied twelve-pin atlas against Riot's interactive-map geography and location data. No redraw is required by this check. Pins are reference locations, not national borders or proof of current political control.
- Riot's Noxus, Piltover and Bilgewater regional text and art, including the Medarda Heirloom image at readable resolution.
- Existing map-team travel guidance; retained rather than converted into a universal speed.
- Travel captions in the recovered Katarina comic, with transport and chronology limitations retained.

The formerly missing atlas attachment was available and inspected. This does not certify the separate character-reference images.

## Travel evidence and its limits

| Journey or source | Actual evidence | Safe use in this project |
|---|---|---|
| Piltover ↔ Bilgewater | The Medarda chart labels this route **18 days**. | A dated trade benchmark. Departure, ship, weather, stops and security still matter. |
| Piltover ↔ Noxus | The same chart labels a Noxus route **19 days**. | A historical route figure, not proof that ships dock at the Immortal Bastion. Modern geography must govern the actual itinerary. |
| Piltover ↔ Basilich | The chart labels **14 days**. | Useful evidence that different Noxian destinations require different schedules. Basilich is not the capital. |
| Noxian capital ↔ Demacian capital | Riot's 2018 map-team AMA estimated roughly **127 days** for a small military force under a specified, unusually favorable direct-march scenario. | Keep its conditions. It is not a civilian courier, ship, flying mount or universal continental-crossing time. |
| Katarina: Stelkenmoor → capital | Issue 1 has a **two-weeks-later** transition. | An elapsed narrative interval, not a surveyed route or proof that every day was spent traveling. |
| Katarina: Demacian forest → Noxian tea house | Issue 4 has another **two-weeks-later** transition following an escape involving a flying raptor. The complete return itinerary is not shown. | An exceptional individual's journey cannot establish an army's marching speed. |
| Noxus ↔ Bilgewater | No verified single universal duration established here. | Do not add 19 and 18 days and call that the direct route. Specify departure port and route first. |
| Zaun ↔ Piltover | Connected vertical urban environments, not two remote countries. | Access, lifts, bridges, raids and the precise starting level can matter more than map distance. No fixed citywide crossing time. |

[G2–G5] The Medarda chart predates the newer world map. Its old coastline and placement must not silently replace modern cartography. Read its numbers as historical evidence, not as a newer map correction.

Arcane S1E4 includes a merchant's warning that, without Hexgates, goods will not reach foreign markets until winter. That establishes the importance of the transport disruption, **not** an exact Piltover–Noxus voyage length: the destination and calendar date are not specified in that exchange. Sun Gates and Hexgates are not interchangeable infrastructure. [G6]

### Working recommendation — not a newly locked decision

For ordinary international travel, plan in **weeks**, then select a route-specific allowance. The 18/19-day figures are useful starting comparisons, not deadlines. A faster method needs an established vehicle or ability, an actual passenger/cargo capacity, and a reason it is available. Do not invent a convenient portal because an episode needs a reunion.

Before an actual journey is outlined, record: departure date and district; embarkation point; destination port or city; transport; passengers and freight; normal passage allowance; disruptions; and arrival date. Keep the calendar offscreen when appropriate, but keep it in the production notes.

### Additional route evidence: Sisterhood of War

Part I gives a week of eastward travel before a southern turn toward the Bloodcliffs, then a few days from there to Drakkengate. At sea, a traveler reports three days elapsed and another three expected to Fae'lor. These are successive legs of this expedition, not a Piltover timetable. The same account contrasts chilly Dalamor with arid southern terrain and shows capital canals, crowded multilingual streets, and public space requisitioned for animals during mobilization. [G11]

### Additional route evidence: Zed

Issue 2 places Qenjo's Qae'lin estate three weeks after the preceding Zhyyun sequence. Issue 5 places a Zaun sequence two weeks after Akali's Ironport sequence; another inquiry establishes that a local remembers her from about a month earlier. Issue 6 returns to Zhyyun near Kashuri three weeks after the Zaun resolution. These captions include off-panel investigation and other actions: none isolates time spent sailing, and none measures Piltover–Noxus. [G12]

The comic shows shipping records, foreign arms purchases and local contacts connecting regions. It also depicts different language proficiencies. That is evidence of a multilingual source world, not authorization to replace any established Elsewhere translation rule. Its map's invasion date and legacy Piltover/Zaun history are not automatically the present chronology of Arcane. [G12]

## Noxus: empire, capital and ordinary life

Noxus is not one giant barracks. Its capital grew around the Immortal Bastion in successive layers, including older streets below newer construction. Fortified buildings, narrow approaches and major gates make military priorities visible in ordinary urban space. Warmasons help extend imperial infrastructure through roads, bridges and fortifications. The empire also contains different local cultures and warbands; Ambessa's expedition is not a template for every Noxian soldier. [G7]

Riot's capital prose places shopkeepers, clerks, servants, shrines and forges alongside its rulers. Darius and Swain do not even share the same class background or manner. The empire's opportunity rhetoric coexists with coercion and surviving noble power. [G8–G9]

### Useful locations and social settings

| Setting | Research basis | What it offers the story without assigning a subplot |
|---|---|---|
| Immortal Bastion and approaches | Official map and regional material | Monumental authority; different access rules from a public street. |
| Layered capital streets | Regional art/text | Shops, workshops, crowded movement, fortified homes and older lower districts. These are descriptive zones, not newly invented official district names. |
| Reckoning arenas | Draven's profile and related narrative sources | Entertainment, reputation and state spectacle. Do not assume one arena has jurisdiction over every fighter. |
| Shuriman Quarter / Immortal Bastion | The Fourth Principle's recovered location lettering | A named source location, not a generic “Noxian district” invented for this project. Its arena and warm-toned monumental art provide local visual references, not a surveyed street plan. [G13] |
| Basilich | *Blood of Noxus* | A fortified port with its own history and grievances, not a miniature interchangeable capital. |
| Rural Noxus | Riven's Trevale background | Farms, labor and family life; ordinary Noxians are not all career soldiers. |
| Conquered and affiliated provinces | Regional material | Local loyalties and negotiated or imposed imperial relationships. Map coloring alone cannot settle a town's current allegiance. |

**Atmosphere for drafting — interpretation:** Make the capital feel inhabited and defensible: stone, cramped older passages, busy trades, banners above people who still need food and rent. Use a forge's heat or an arena crowd where the scene actually encounters it. Do not give every street permanent red fog, perpetual screaming or identical weather. Provincial landscapes and wealth should change the sensory detail.

### Newly recovered location labels do not create a timetable

The Demon's Hand's introductory text names Noshthay Valley, Elmunt and Qualthala, with battlefield, mountain and forest settings. Those captions do not establish exact coordinates, current imperial ownership, distance between scenes or the duration of the demon's movements. Do not pin them onto the accepted atlas by guesswork or use the sequence as an ordinary travel itinerary. [G14]

### Cinematic setting extension

Welcome to Noxus now has a timestamped visual-sampling record in KAZE_League_Cinematic_Evidence_Ledger.md, C1. Fortiche's commentary distinguishes the depicted Freljord and Noxian environments and emphasizes architecture, materials and costume hierarchy. This adds a scene-design reference, not new coordinates, national climate rules or voyage durations. The apparent proximity of locations created by an edit must not replace the established travel ledger. No atlas revalidation or new map pin was performed. [G15]

## Bilgewater is not an empty market waiting for Heisenberg

Official regional material distinguishes the port city from the surrounding Serpent/Blue Flame Isles and their Buhru culture. Cliffs, treacherous approaches, canals and improvised construction shape the city. The Slaughter Docks support an industry processing sea monsters, not merely a decorative pirate waterfront. Wealth and risk vary with elevation. [G10]

**Application:** Heisenberg's accepted foothold abroad needs local relationships and a sustained route. Product arriving in a harbor does not mean control of that harbor. Existing captains, workers, traders and communities retain interests of their own. This research does not appoint a specific Bilgewater champion as his ally or enemy.

## Consequences for the existing plan

1. **The Noxus cut and the Zaun cut need not be simultaneous.** Date changes can be implicit to viewers but must agree in the production calendar.
2. **People, information and cargo travel differently.** A raven sighting is not proof that Swain instantly knows every conversation; a message arriving ahead of a ship does not teleport its cargo.
3. **Daredevil's two-region investigation needs actual absences.** He cannot spend the same night in both cities without an established exception.
4. **The Sins' departure leaves consequences behind.** Their Zaun assets can persist, but their physical protection is not automatically present while the gang is abroad.
5. **The newcomers' elapsed time remains unresolved.** The previously recorded seventeen-day segment is not the whole season. Do not backfill months of offscreen conquest from it.

Riot public client sources and exact coverage are L15 in KAZE_League_Comics_Evidence_Ledger.md. Text and raw art are not a complete animated performance or scale map.
- **G14 — The Demon's Hand:** introductory location strings read directly in Riot's 23-entry English ComicCopy table and reconciled with the reproduced narrative. Exact primary URL and recovery details are L17 in the League ledger. No new route duration inferred.

Commentary read and the linked film visually sampled; exact frame coverage and chronology cautions are C1 in KAZE_League_Cinematic_Evidence_Ledger.md. Neither source supplies a surveyed journey.

**Completed here:** atlas compatibility, named route evidence, regional physical/civilian texture, newly recovered source location labels, and travel-planning constraints. **Not established:** exact current journey times, the whole branch calendar, additional invented districts, selected travel method, or new character locations. The initial atlas validation was preserved, not repeated.

SEASON 3 — ROSTER FIDELITY AUDIT AND EVIDENCE REGISTER
7 October 2026. This closes the task’s roster inventory/review and gives every operative identity a source route. It does NOT claim every character has a completed audiovisual dossier. The evidence and gaps below are part of the result, not concealed behind an “all passed” label.

SCOPE / NO DUPLICATES
37 operative character identities: all seven current Sins, ten solo newcomer tracks including Dutch van der Linde, Jörmungandr, twelve Noxian natives, Teemo, Frank, Matt, Jesse, Heisenberg, 47 and Ryuk. The latest explicit user correction admits DUTCH ONLY; the entire Van der Linde gang is not imported. Arthur remains the existing branch person. Black Mimir is a separate narrator review. Chris and Billy are two people sharing one exterior body; the count is identities, not simultaneous exterior bodies. The global crossover registry is not a demand to put every admitted entity into S3.
Conditional surviving Zaun/Piltover actors retain Season2_Cast_Fidelity_Audit.md and native profile evidence. Their actual S2 outcome governs S3 availability. Vi/Jinx are alive at D70 but selected for eventual death; no live S3 role is guaranteed. Rictus is already dead. Nessa is a branch person and needs branch fidelity, not a fictitious external franchise dossier. No new cast member is silently admitted by this audit.

WHAT WAS ACTUALLY EXTENDED
• Heimdall: official guide downloaded, text extracted, costume/face pages 4–5 inspected; combat owner expanded to action-by-action anticipation, physical response, counters and intact-body limits. Prior failed PDF access is now historical.
• Twelve Noxian natives: official base portraits inspected, official current champion profiles/ability vocabulary read, dedicated profiles preserve their earlier individual dialogue/story/comic evidence.
• Seven other solo import files: prior completed scene research retained at individual retrieval points with explicit visual, action, motivation and version boundaries. Thor/Jörmungandr/Heimdall already had individual owners and were reconciled.
• Dutch van der Linde: latest scope correction applied across roster, outline and source routing. The prior 21 supporting-member files are marked inactive historical research. Their research gaps no longer belong to current S3 work. Dutch retains his own selected source interval and individual evidence limits; Arthur remains current.
• Core/carryover: original custom kits and later corrections remain. Matt, Jesse, 47, Ryuk and Black Mimir now also have dedicated retrieval files. Existing Brok, Arthur, Billy, Chris, Frank and Teemo research is reused rather than restarted.

EVIDENCE GRADES
INSPECTED VISUAL means the stated actual image/pages were seen. READ TEXT means the stated biography, scene, script, transcript or production account was read. RETAINED means earlier completed work is preserved with its original limits. APPLICATION means an original writing consequence of those sources. OPEN means unverified, not false and not permission to invent a restrictive mechanic. None of these means a complete performance was watched or heard unless explicitly stated.

5. Cross-franchise interactions are not source canon. Resolve only the material case using actual mechanisms, distances, information, available responses and branch rules. Do not turn research uncertainty into universal immunity or an arbitrary nerf.

HEIMDALL COMBAT — WHAT A DRAFT MUST SHOW
A readable intention produces a physical answer: early movement, angle change, interception or selected block followed by counterpressure. His first exchange should demonstrate this successfully. Hofuð, Bifröst and Realm Shift remain part of the intact-body repertoire. Awareness is not intangibility; knowing and physically escaping are different. Sincere mistaken belief can defeat his inference without making his intention-reading false. A new threat must survive his ability to observe and adapt. No drunkenness, animal instinct, mask, eye cover, random movement, extra attacker or Kaze fourth wall is an automatic counter. Draupnir is the game’s demonstrated solution, not a universal key restriction.

FIGHT CONSEQUENCES / FIDELITY APPLICATION
A memorable encounter can resolve quickly if the actual power relationship warrants it. Establish motive, place, objective, full current kit, decisive action and changed aftermath. Let a defeated character lose the object of the fight, a resource, trust or status. Do not preserve every opponent for a later roster demonstration. Characters can retreat only through a real available route and an intelligible choice. Preserve injuries, blood, damaged equipment, property, witnesses, knowledge and retaliation after the cut.

NEW SOURCE REGISTER / PRECISE COVERAGE
Official Heimdall visual guide: https://secure.cdn.us.playstation.com/god-of-war-ragnarok/cosplay/god-of-war-ragnarok-cosplay-guide-heimdall.pdf — full PDF available; pages 4–5 visually inspected; text extracted. Guide annotations include in-character speculation, not objective mechanisms.
Noxian native profiles: https://www.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/champions/ followed by swain, leblanc, darius, draven, katarina, talon, riven, samira, vladimir, elise, sion or briar. Each exact route and inspected base-image URL is in that individual owner. No alternative skin is a new form. LeBlanc’s current visual update was cross-checked against https://www.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/news/game-updates/patch-25-07-notes/ .
Van der Linde: https://news.xbox.com/en-us/2018/09/07/meet-the-van-der-linde-gang-from-red-dead-redemption-2/ — publisher-distributed seven-character profiles. https://digitalchumps.com/2018/09/07/red-dead-redemption-2-introduces-the-van-der-linde-gang/ — reproduction of Rockstar’s promotional biographies, not an independent source or audio audition. The direct Rockstar route failed; no claim it was read.

# Female roster and romance WORK update

No episode generated. Delivered E20 remains the endpoint; E21 is still unwritten. Kaze retains solo focus, meeting Briar first in Noxus; ensemble presentation pauses while world time and consequences continue. The saved replacement set is prepared, not verified live-installed.

## What the recovered scenes support

Gwen and Tristana: specific, reciprocal banter, decisive mutual invitations, familiar aftermath, and continuing independent loyalties. Tristana’s explicit author age18 is a character setting, not an earned story outcome, and is retained. Gwen’s prior adult-eligibility selection is retained without inventing a human age. The recovered accounts are summaries of prior delivered passages, not a newly recovered complete manuscript.

Camille: confrontation over property → repeated verbal sparring → a real change in circumstances when Kaze returns the damaged assembly → dinner on her terms → mutually chosen intimacy → ongoing Ferros priorities. The archive confirms those steps; it does not support claiming her resistance itself was consent.

Application: Kaze remains bold, profane, funny and sexually interested. Flirting develops through real exchanges and changed choices; avoid an endless loop of the same refusal and invitation. Sarcastic pushback is read in context, not automatically treated as either consent or a blanket ban. A clear no stops that advance; she can later independently reopen it. Suggestive banter belongs before the cut and in the aftermath; sexual acts and erotic act-by-act dialogue remain off-page. Adult consensual threesomes and foursomes can be explicitly confirmed off-page, with every participant choosing; no mandatory group, quota or automatic Briar participation. Existing relationships keep memories, teasing, arguments and consequences.

## Current life and solo decisions

Samira, Vi, Jinx, Caitlyn and Ambessa receive the authorized living-return override. Isolde, Norra and Tristana keep explicit living pins. Grayson, Sky Young and Cassandra Kiramman remain DEAD. Other broad female-life coverage remains subject to those exceptions and source form. Death history, crimes, memories and actual property custody stay; no resurrection scene, new power, duplicate loot or automatic knowledge is created.

Kaze starts in Noxus, with his E20 Zaun-to-Noxus travel accounted for when PLAY is requested. Briar is the first woman he meets: their former shared history is now explicitly superseded, and an early mutual hookup is selected as a future development. Regions may change. Baldur/Kratos and all selected developments remain opportunities; no mandatory fight order after the start. World time continues and Kaze may face consequences caused by any Sin, through actual witnesses and information. E20 and its checkpoint remain byte-for-byte unchanged; no episode generated.

## Sources and limits

The retained full roster and structured Runeterra owners support this catalog; the audit preserves per-entry source/version selectors. The old romance evidence and full-source limitations above remain. Public regional exceptions rechecked through Riot profiles: [Nami](https://www.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/champions/nami/), [Poppy](https://www.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/champions/poppy/), [Senna](https://www.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/champions/senna/), [Mel](https://www.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/champions/mel/), [Riven](https://www.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/champions/riven/). Detailed Noxus primary links are in research/Noxus_Women_20261018.md. Source association is never present location; public later lore is not an automatic branch update.

## Latest first-meeting correction

Kaze and Briar have never met in the revised prospective continuity. Preserve old manuscripts exactly as evidence, but exclude their shared scenes, intimacy, relationship-dependent gifts/knowledge and joint travel from the new solo. Briar is not already in BELLY or already traveling with Kaze. She is the first female encounter in Noxus; reciprocal chemistry and an early mutual hookup lead into their ongoing adventures. Keep unrelated Sins/world consequences. No new scene has been written. See state/work/Briar_First_Meeting_Author_Override_20261018.json.

# Noxus women — source and story application

WORK only, 18 October 2026 Honolulu. This updates the existing research and roster audit; it does not create encounters, attraction, contracts, consent or locations. Kaze's solo with Briar begins in Noxus, with other regions available through travel and choice. Current branch snapshots override later public lore outcomes.

## Principal adult women

| Character | Source identity and agenda | Application to this branch |
|---|---|---|
| Samira | Shuriman-born Noxian daredevil who seeks dangerous work and expressive combat. | Living return remains authorized. Her E14 killing by Arthur and lost weapons matter; no automatic forgiveness, identical replacement guns or romantic response. |
| Katarina | Ambitious Du Couteau assassin whose duty and professional decisions drive action. | Give her an actual assignment, knowledge and judgment. Do not make her Swain's remote puppet or grant later comic blade upgrades automatically. |
| Cassiopeia | Du Couteau noblewoman transformed while seeking power in Shurima. | Keep the serpentine body, manipulation and family interests. No arbitrary human form or harmless seductress rewrite. |
| LeBlanc | Long-lived Black Rose manipulator whose identity and operations are elusive. | Her information comes through actual observation and networks. An encounter can be deceptive without giving her omniscience or making every plot hers. |
| Elise | Former noblewoman, now a predatory spiderlike being with social access in Noxus. | Adult woman/monster fidelity and her own appetite matter. Her allure does not establish consent or compel Kaze. |
| Riven | Former Noxian swordmaster whose faith broke in the Ionian war. | Noxian origin does not put her in Noxus now. Exile, capture and return are different phases; preserve her source and branch route. |
| Ambessa | General and Medarda matriarch intent on family power and survival. | Author living-return override applies. Her branch history, loss and independent aims remain; no instant restoration of every troop, office or possession. |
| Mel | Noxian-born Medarda politician with an independent relationship to her family and the Black Rose. | Current public biography is later than parts of the branch. Her return to Noxus and full later abilities are not automatically imported. |
| Briar | Adult blood-magic creation learning to choose her own life beyond her makers' orders. | Has not met Kaze under the latest author correction; first woman encountered in the Noxus solo, with early mutual intimacy planned. Curiosity, hunger, autonomy and her reactions continue throughout the solo. |

## Champion scope

Rell and Annie are Noxian champions, retained as nonsexual story characters. The requested list is champions only. Supporting-person research remains evidence and does not add compulsory encounters. Mel has both Noxian origin and Piltover ties; Riven's Noxian origin does not certify present residence.

## Consequences during solo focus

The presentation follows Kaze and Briar. The world keeps its history and continues acting. Kaze can face the fallout of his own actions and the other Sins' actions through recognizable association, witnesses, evidence, debts, allies, victims and independent agendas. No character receives the project files as knowledge. A mistaken accusation needs a plausible source; an accurate accusation does not guarantee an execution squad.

Keep pressure varied: refusal of service, altered prices, a frightened witness, a disputed claim, a bounty, surveillance, negotiations, competing offers, an ambush or someone trying to exploit the reputation. These are possible responses, not pre-enacted facts or a mandatory revenge parade. People may be self-interested, divided, mistaken or unwilling to escalate. Romance does not cancel those interests.

At preparation for each episode, identify the pressure's actual cause, who witnessed/learned what, how information traveled, the elapsed time, the actor's desired outcome and available means. Then let the actors choose. No routine cutaways to the paused ensemble are required. No backdated proof may be invented to justify a desired outcome.

**Grayson, Sky Young and Cassandra Kiramman remain dead.** This explicit exception overrides the earlier blanket female revival and is controlling everywhere. The other authorized female returns remain, without erasing their historical deaths or automatically restoring gear, relationships or offices.

## Public evidence checked in this update

- [Noxus regional index](https://universe.leagueoflegends.com/en_US/region/noxus/): official search index recovered the regional champion list; direct page rendered only a shell. Do not call this a fresh full-page prose read.
- Official readable profiles: [Samira](https://www.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/champions/samira/), [Katarina](https://www.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/champions/katarina/), [Cassiopeia](https://www.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/champions/cassiopeia/), [LeBlanc](https://www.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/champions/leblanc/), [Elise](https://www.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/champions/elise/), [Riven](https://www.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/champions/riven/), [Ambessa](https://www.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/champions/ambessa/), [Mel](https://www.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/champions/mel/), [Briar creator article](https://www.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/news/dev/champion-insights-briar/), [Rell creator article](https://www.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/news/dev/champion-insights-rell/).
- Michael Luo's Riot story [Daredevil Impulse, reproduced by THE RUNE](https://therune.lol/lore/stories/samira-color-story/): full rendered story read; official original returned a shell. Supports Indari, Lani/Miel and Samira's social/work behavior. Mirror is not Riot's own website.
- Ian St. Martin's Riot [Sisterhood of War I](https://therune.lol/lore/stories/sisterhood-of-war-i/) and [III](https://therune.lol/lore/stories/sisterhood-of-war-iii/): targeted passages rechecked; prior complete three-part research reused from reference/research/Noxus_Cast_Fidelity_Research.md, N27–N29. No claim that all three were freshly reread this update.

Character interactions suggested above are writing inferences from those sources, not canonically predetermined romantic responses. No need to ask the author to select every possible meeting in advance.
